scripts.build: bun run generate:brand && tsc -b && vite build && bun run scripts/prerender.tsx
scripts.audit:brand: bun run build && bun run scripts/visual/prepare-brand-reference.ts && playwright test tests/visual/brand-compare.spec.ts --project=brand-audit && bun run scripts/visual/compose-brand-qa.ts
scripts.audit:brand:update: bun run build && bun run scripts/visual/prepare-brand-reference.ts && playwright test tests/visual/brand-compare.spec.ts --project=brand-audit --update-snapshots && bun run scripts/visual/compose-brand-qa.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
